screened_source.title: Characterization of matrices with bounded Graver bases and depth parameters and applications to integer programming
screened_source.read_scope: Definitions in Section 2.4, Theorem 10 statement, and complete Section 7 quadratic-depth sharpness construction and proof. It concerns actual-element versus arbitrary-vector contraction depth; no new statement is imported as a premise.

disposition: Quadratic depth sharpness blocks a universal linear circumference-to-depth improvement but does not settle size-sensitive puncture separation. The new proof instead retains the represented covering-radius deficit. Only the previously audited bounded-circumference depth theorem is a dependency.
retrieval: PMC interstitial and repository PDF tool failure preceded successful publisher HTML and arXiv access. No third-party full text downloaded or retained.
novelty: Bounded primary-source and registry searches did not identify the exact deficit-to-puncture statement. Independent novelty remains unassessed; no absence claim.
